verdict.rationale: Linear exposes a full GraphQL API with OAuth2/personal API key auth, webhooks, and a typed SDK, which together enable scripted/headless automation suitable for CI pipelines (e.g., creating/updating issues, listening to events). However, there's no explicit CI-specific tooling (CLI, GitHub Action, non-interactive agent runner) documented, so support is inferred from general API primitives rather than purpose-built CI integration.
